subject: Supplier activation: PO requirements, line-item mapping, and timeline
messages:
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: ops@cumulussupplies.com
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 09 Jan 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Supplier activation: PO requirements, line-item mapping, and timeline

Hi Jamie / Cumulus ops team,

Thanks for agreeing to kick off the vendor activation. To get you fully set up in our procurement system we need to confirm a few PO and onboarding items so our finance and operations teams can issue POs and process invoices without delays. Please review and reply with any constraints or a target date for delivery of required docs.

Checklist (requested items)
- Completed supplier onboarding form (attached) — includes legal name, remit-to, tax ID, and banking.
- W-9 (US vendors) or equivalent tax docs.
- COI / insurance certificate if available.
- Vendor portal account or EDI/CSV PO ingestion method (we can send test PO). If you support EDI, include the endpoint and credentials.
- Preferred invoice format and required invoice fields.

Key PO requirements from Redwood (please confirm you can comply):
- PO number must be referenced as PO_NUM on the invoice and in the invoice filename.
- Line items must include: SKU, line_description, qty, unit_cost, currency (ISO), tax_amount, shipping_code, and total_line_amount.
- If you submit partial shipments, please indicate how you provide remaining quantities and partial-invoice references.
- Redwood accounting prefers one invoice per PO but will accept partial-invoice flows if partial shipment flags are present.

Timeline request
- Please return onboarding docs and portal access within 3 business days if possible.
- Once vendor is created we will issue the initial PO within 48 hours.

Attachments: supplier_onboarding_form.pdf, sample_po_template.csv (sample CSV column layout).

Goal: have vendor fully active for PO issuance for our initial order (forecasted ship week: 2027-01-25) by Jan 14.

If anything here is a hard requirement on your side (billing cadence, currency constraints, EDI availability), flag it in your reply.

Thanks,
Laura
Laura Bennett
Procurement Manager | Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com
+1 415-555-0167

--
Redwood Inference — Production-first LLM inference
From: Jamie Park <jamie.park@cumulussupplies.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: ops@cumulussupplies.com
Date: Mon, 11 Jan 2027 10:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Supplier activation: PO requirements, line-item mapping, and timeline

Laura — thanks for the clear checklist. Quick confirmations below and attached: signed_onboarding_form.pdf and W-9_Cumulus.pdf.

- We completed and attached the onboarding form; bank details included.
- We can accept the PO_NUM requirement and will include PO_NUM on the invoice header and filename.
- Line-item fields: our ERP exports SKU, description, qty, unit_price, tax, and freight. We can append unit_cost -> unit_price and provide currency (USD). Will include shipping_code field on invoice.
- Partial shipments: supported. We will include a shipment_reference on partial invoices and a remaining_qty field.
- EDI: we do not have full ANSI X12 EDI today; we can support SFTP CSV ingestion with a header row that matches your sample. Send a test CSV and credentials and we will onboard the parser on our side.
- Lead time: standard turnaround for initial PO is 7–10 business days after PO receipt (longer if special MTO items).

Open questions for Redwood:
1) Bill-to and remit-to: confirm the remit-to address on the attached onboarding form is OK for your AP team.
2) Do you require an insurance certificate before first shipment? We can provide it, but need a week to update our broker if needed.

Next steps:
- We returned the completed onboarding form and W-9 (attached).
- Please confirm SFTP credentials for CSV PO ingestion and we will test.

Thanks,
Jamie Park
Ops Lead — Cumulus Supplies
jamie.park@cumulussupplies.com
+1 206-555-0198

Laura / Marissa — adding the AP/ERP perspective so we don't have to backtrack later:

AP confirmation items (requirements from Redwood accounting):
- Invoice parsing expects a header with PO_NUM, INVOICE_NUM, INVOICE_DATE, NET_DUE_DATE.
- Line CSV columns we need: PO_NUM, LINE_NO, SKU, DESCRIPTION, QTY, UNIT_COST, TAX_AMOUNT, SHIPPING_CODE, LINE_TOTAL, CURRENCY. (sample mapping attached earlier).
- Tax handling: include tax breakdown per line; our tax engine will reconcile by SKU tax code but having tax_amount per line is required for automated matching.
- Currency: Redwood processes in USD for this buyer account; if you invoice in another currency we'll need a clear fx_rate field.
- GL mapping: we will provide the GL code per PO in the PO header; please pass that to your invoice processor so GL is present on invoice lines if possible.

Operational notes:
- For SFTP CSV ingestion, we will drop a test PO.csv to the path you provide; please confirm the filename convention. We will also accept emailed PDFs but prefer CSV for automated matching.
- For partial shipments, ensure each partial invoice references the original PO_NUM and includes a PARTIAL_SEQ field (1/2, 2/3, etc.) and a remaining_qty value.

If Cumulus can return the SFTP details we will coordinate a test drop this week and generate the first PO after the vendor profile is created in NetAP/ERP.

Thanks,
Dev Patel
Finance Systems | Redwood Inference
dev.patel@redwoodinference.com

Subject: Re: Supplier activation: PO requirements, line-item mapping, and timeline

Jamie — thanks for the quick turnaround and for sending the signed docs. Summary and agreed next steps below so everyone has a single source of truth.

Agreed items (summary)
- Vendor onboarding: Cumulus returned completed supplier_onboarding_form.pdf and W-9_Cumulus.pdf. Redwood will ingest these into vendor master and confirm remit-to address.
- PO format: Redwood requires PO_NUM on invoice and filename; line items must include SKU, description, qty, unit_cost, tax_amount, shipping_code, currency, and line_total.
- EDI/ingestion: Cumulus to provide SFTP CSV endpoint. Redwood will send a test CSV (sample_po_template.csv) within 24 hours of receiving credentials.
- Partial shipments: supported. Use PARTIAL_SEQ and remaining_qty fields; include shipment_reference.
- Lead time: Cumulus target 7–10 business days for first PO fulfillment. Redwood notes expected ship week 2027-01-25; both sides will reconcile if any critical path items appear.
- Insurance: not required before vendor activation; if you have a COI please share but we will not hold PO issuance on that alone.

Immediate next steps (owner / ETA)
- Cumulus (owner): provide SFTP credentials for CSV ingestion and confirm remit-to address / any special billing notes (ETA: 1 business day).
- Redwood (owner): create vendor profile and issue initial PO once SFTP confirmed (ETA: Redwood to issue PO within 48 hours after vendor profile is ready).
- Dev / Finance (owner): run SFTP test and validate CSV mapping; will confirm acceptance or request mapping tweaks (ETA: 2 business days).

If all looks good we'll aim to issue PO-20270113-0001 as the first test PO. Please reply to confirm SFTP path and whether you need any sample GL mapping fields included in the CSV.

Thanks again — copying our finance systems lead (Dev) and fulfillment (Marissa) to keep the loop tight.

Best,
Laura
